capabilities: Align images left, center, or right from the context menu, command palette, or hotkeys
Apply width and height size markers to images inside callouts
Store alignment as Markdown image alt markers
Configure a default alignment for images without explicit markers
Keep the image visible while showing Markdown source via Edit this block
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. The listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Alignment markers remain in Markdown if the plugin is disabled, though the default-alignment CSS stops applying.
intentEvidence: Better Live Preview Image improves image alignment and callout image sizing in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's Live Preview offers no built-in way to align images or make width and height size markers work on images inside callouts.
summary: Live Preview image helper that aligns images left, center, or right and applies width and height markers to images inside callouts.
